```yaml
name: Update ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-for-updates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          check-latest: true

      - name: Get current ingestr version
        id: current_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -o 'ingestrVersion = "[^"]*"' main.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check for latest ingestr version
        id: latest_version
        run: |
          LATEST_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Compare versions
        id: compare_versions
        run: |
          if [ "${{ env.current_version }}" != "${{ env.latest_version }}" ]; then
            echo "version_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "version_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.version_changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update ingestr to ${{ env.latest_version }}"
          title: "Update ingestr to ${{ env.latest_version }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the ingestr version from ${{ env.current_version }} to ${{ env.latest_version }}.
            
            Automated PR from update-ingestr workflow.
          branch: update-ingestr-${{ env.latest_version }}
          delete-branch: true
          labels: dependencies
          assignees: ${{ github.actor }}
```
